D: A young deer grows up in the forest with his friends Thumper and Flower.
P: Serve the snacks when Thumper teaches Bambi to eat the clover.
S: Thumper telling Bambi to eat the clover and leave the greens
Baby leaves, pea shoots and soft herbs tossed with lemon and olive oil, spooned into little lettuce cups with shaved parmesan and toasted seeds.
Flower the skunk in the flower patch
Baby carrots, radishes and snow peas arranged like a garden bed around a dip of whipped feta, yoghurt, honey and dill.

Crisp little shortcrust cases filled with vanilla custard and piled with strawberries, blueberries and raspberries, dusted with icing sugar. Cut 12 rounds from 2 shortcrust sheets and press into a muffin tin. Prick and bake at 180C for 12 minutes until golden, then cool. Heat 300ml milk with 1 tsp vanilla. Whisk 3 egg yolks, 60g sugar and 2 tbsp cornflour, pour in the hot milk, return to the pan and stir until thick. Cool, then spoon into the cases and top with 250g mixed berries. Dust with icing sugar.
M: the deep forest where the Great Prince watches
Mixed mushrooms, leek and thyme cooked down in butter with a splash of cream, spooned into a dish, topped with puff pastry and baked at 200C for 25 minutes.
Bambi seeing snow for the first time

Roasted pumpkin and carrot blended silky with stock, cream and nutmeg, served with a snowy swirl of cream and crunchy garlic toasts. Toss 1.2kg pumpkin chunks, 2 chopped carrots and 1 quartered onion with oil and salt and roast at 200C for 35 minutes. Blend with 1L chicken or vegetable stock until smooth, then reheat with 100ml cream and a pinch of nutmeg and season. Slice a baguette, brush with oil, rub with garlic and toast at 200C for 8 minutes. Serve the soup with a swirl of cream and the toasts.
W: Bambi slipping around on the frozen pond
Meringue spread into a flat round, baked at 120C for 90 minutes, cooled in the oven, topped with whipped cream like snow and fresh berries.
K: spring in the meadow, when everyone is twitterpated
Apple juice and cold elderflower cordial topped with soda water, with cucumber ribbons and mint over ice.

s.note: Thumper telling Bambi to eat the clover and leave the greens
s.how: Separate baby cos lettuce into small cups. Toss pea shoots and mint leaves with lemon juice and olive oil and spoon into each cup. Top with shaved parmesan and toasted pepitas. Serve on a platter in the spring sunshine.

s.note: Flower the skunk in the flower patch
s.how: Whip 200g feta with 200g Greek yoghurt, a spoon of honey and chopped dill until smooth. Spread in a shallow dish and arrange baby carrots, radishes and snow peas around it like a garden bed. Serve chilled.

m.note: the deep forest where the Great Prince watches
m.how: Slice 600g mixed mushrooms and a leek and cook in butter with thyme until soft and golden. Add 200ml cream and simmer until thick. Spoon into a pie dish, top with puff pastry, brush with milk and bake at 200C for 25 minutes.

w.note: Bambi slipping around on the frozen pond
w.how: Whisk 4 egg whites to stiff peaks, then add 220g caster sugar a spoon at a time until glossy. Fold in a teaspoon of cornflour. Spread into a flat round like a frozen pond and bake at 120C for 90 minutes. Cool and top with whipped cream and berries.

d.note: spring in the meadow, when everyone is twitterpated
d.how: Fill tall glasses with ice, cucumber ribbons and mint leaves. Pour in apple juice to halfway and add a splash of elderflower cordial. Top with cold soda water and stir gently. Fresh as the first day of spring in the meadow.
